editorial:
Imagine it is 1943 and you are celebrating your birthday, but instead of a nice gift, you end up with top-secret government plans. That is exactly what happens to Cora Apple and her sisters, Seedy and Candy. These three are not spies or geniuses; they are just ordinary women who get caught in a wild mess. After a package swap goes wrong, the Nazis think they are brilliant scientists working on the Manhattan Project and kidnap them. It is a fast, funny ride that feels like those old-school movies where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, but in the most entertaining way possible.

You will love how the sisters use their quick wit and a lot of luck to trick the villains. The acting is snappy, and the pacing never slows down, though some of the plot twists are a bit silly. If you enjoy comedies that don't take themselves too seriously, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the final act, the Apple sisters use their charm to distract the Nazi officers while they sneakily send the stolen plans back to the US government. They manage to trigger a huge explosion in the enemy base, allowing them to escape just in time. The movie wraps up with the sisters being honored as accidental heroes. They get a huge reward, and Cora finally gets the actual birthday present she wanted at the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-fashioned comedies and mistaken identity stories.
